## Safety / traceability
- [ ] No loss of runtime features, tests, fixtures, schemas or downstream contracts
- [ ] No private media, secrets, analyses, PII or unsafe public Actions artifacts

- [ ] No forced unrelated-history merge or rewrite of protected branch history
